orchestrator-validator.primary_outcome: Dispatch the next bounded slice while keeping validation and routing truthful.
core_responsibilities: Select the governed next step from the declared decision space.
Keep dispatches aligned to the parent-only handoff contract.
runtime_truth_requirements: Carry forward exact runtime-truth claims from the upstream handoff.
command_evidence_requirements: Require activation and validation commands before dispatch.
orchestrator-validator.decision_space_expectation: Require 3+ viable options with one recommended path.
orchestrator-validator.extension_request_policy: Emit a governed extension request instead of inventing a new agent or capability.

research.primary_outcome: Tighten bounded evidence or dependency understanding without widening the slice.
core_responsibilities: Verify exact upstream claims before proposing new work.
Return only bounded evidence that supports the next governed step.
runtime_truth_requirements: Do not upgrade blocked lanes without fresh proof artifacts.
command_evidence_requirements: Pair every claim with the command or artifact that supports it.
research.decision_space_expectation: Return at least three options when routing the next research or architecture step.
research.extension_request_policy: Use a governed extension request when the needed capability is outside the current harvested set.

architect.primary_outcome: Convert reviewed evidence into the next bounded contract update.
core_responsibilities: Keep the next prompt bounded to the declared parent surfaces.
Preserve the structured contract family as machine truth.
runtime_truth_requirements: Keep runtime-truth fields explicit in the next structured prompt.
command_evidence_requirements: Name the exact command-evidence contract the next worker must preserve.
architect.decision_space_expectation: Offer at least three viable implementation or escalation options.
architect.extension_request_policy: Request a governed extension instead of broadening beyond current parent-native surfaces.

requirements: Keep blocked lanes explicit when dependencies are unchanged.
Keep upstream runtime proof artifacts attached to the next governed slice.
Require activation and validation commands in every governed follow-up prompt.
Require dispatch output to point back to the structured prompt artifact.
